# govengers/telemetry

> Metrics bootstrap and tracing setup for govengers services: Prometheus registry with runtime collectors, internal /metrics server, Gin RED middleware by route template, OpenTelemetry tracer provider from OTEL_* (no-op without an endpoint, query values redacted), trace.id and trace.span_id on the wide event.

- Module: `github.com/govengers/telemetry`, Go 1.26, Apache 2.0.
- One owner per signal: wide events are the logs, Prometheus `client_golang` the metrics, OpenTelemetry traces only. No OTel metrics or logs SDK.
- Packages: `telemetry` (NewRegistry, NewMetricsServer, MethodLabel; imports only client_golang), `ginadapter` (NewMetricsMiddleware: `<ns>_http_requests_total{route,method,status}`, `<ns>_http_request_duration_seconds{route,method}`, `<ns>_http_requests_in_flight`), `tracing` (New, Provider.TracerProvider, Provider.Shutdown, Provider.Enabled, RecordTraceID, KeyTraceID, KeySpanID).
- Wiring: `otel.SetTracerProvider(traces.TracerProvider())` and `otel.SetTextMapPropagator(propagation.TraceContext{})` in main; otelgin first, outside the recovery and before the wide-event middleware; `PreEnricher: func(we, ginContext) { tracing.RecordTraceID(ginContext.Request.Context(), we) }`; otelhttp.NewTransport for outbound HTTP, otelpgx.NewTracer for pgx, redisotel.InstrumentTracing with WithDBStatement(false) for Redis.
- Config: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (or _TRACES_ENDPOINT) turns tracing on; OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true or OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER=none turns it off; only http/protobuf. Sampler stays ParentBased(AlwaysOn), tail sampling in the collector.
- Standards: govengers/standards `library` profile; rules MET, TRC, LOG.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): packages, metrics, tracing, configuration, instrumentation.
- [docs/wiki/Home.md](docs/wiki/Home.md): what goes where, bootstrap order, drain sequence, gotchas.
- [test/e2e/telemetry_test.go](test/e2e/telemetry_test.go): the full wiring against an OTLP receiver and a downstream service.
